name: Albert Auburne
source:
Likes: His younger sister and Klaus
Dislikes: Anything that isn't gentlemanly
Hobby: Gathering information
Skill: Talking

"I'll only tell you, and you alone...about my secret, that is."

Florin: Albert is a Rare Species Case Officer from the Ministry of Magic.
It's his job to protect rare species of beasts from all over the world.
Also, he's the intermediary between us, the White Dragon Knights, and the Ministry of Magic.
He's also a noble of the Gedonelune, and the current head of the Auburne family!
Can you believe it? He's a marquis!
He's quiet and reserved, he always smiles, and he has a gentlemanly attitude, so he's pretty popular among the nobles and the people of the Ministry of Magic.
However, he gathers information from all over the world and uses it to make deals with people.
You need to watch out for him, so make sure you don't show him any weaknesses!
Recently, it seems like he hasn't been able to calm down about something though.
It's not like him. I wonder what happened.

[Official in-game description]
